lines.text: Many learners say: I go to school by foot.
Better: I go to school on foot.
Say on foot. Not by foot.
On! We went home on foot.

data.wrong: I go to school by foot.
data.right: I go to school on foot.
data.why: Say on foot. Not by foot.

native.tip: “步行”的固定说法是 “on foot”，不是 by foot。

en.tip: “On foot” is the fixed phrase for walking, not “by foot”.
en.caption: Do you say “I go to school by foot.”? 😅 On foot is the fixed phrase for walking: “I go to school on foot.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
